It yields eighteen consumables, with the {{Color|Common}} rarity consumables being the most common. This crate gives four consumables when unlocked. As there is no limit on how many consumables you can have, it is possible to get duplicates of them from this crate. ==Methods of Obtaining== #Purchased in the store for {{Coins|300}}. #Weekly Quests.
